functions.name: numbers
docs: Streams `1..=count` (an empty or huge count behaves as written).

functions.name: samples
docs: Streams `count` alternating-axis samples.

functions.name: fizzbuzz
docs: The classic transform: items of `1..=count` mapped to their
fizzbuzz word (a stream of strings).

functions.name: readings
docs: A slow PUSH producer: one reading per 5 ms tick, delivered with
backpressure through the bounded buffer. JS pulls with
`for await` exactly like the pull streams above.

functions.name: checked_readings
docs: A PUSH producer delivering `Result` items: even ticks arrive as
values, odd ticks as item errors (`ctx.push(Ok/Err)` - the item
itself carries the domain outcome, the stream still completes).

functions.name: flaky
docs: Result items: even indexes arrive as values, odd ones as item
errors (the JS iterator throws at the first error item). The
parens are the documented workaround for generic bindings in
impl-trait position.

functions.name: big_values
docs: Values descending from the u64 maximum (exact BigInt delivery).
